name: @reliverse/rengine-monorepo
description: Rengine is an open-source 2D and 3D game engine for building games, interactive tools, and content creation workflows.
author: Nazarii Korniienko <blefnk@gmail.com>

scripts.rese:build: bun run --filter='@reliverse/rese' build && bun run --filter='@repo/rese-web' build && bun run --filter='@repo/rese-wiki' build && bun run --filter='@reliverse/rese-core' build
scripts.rese:typecheck: bun run --filter='@reliverse/rese' typecheck && bun run --filter='@repo/rese-web' typecheck && bun run --filter='@repo/rese-wiki' typecheck && bun run --filter='@reliverse/rese-core' typecheck
